summary: Robo.ai Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, reporting its acquisition of QC Capital Limited via its subsidiary Roboai Investments L.L.C-FZ. The registrant is the issuer/acquirer. The agreement, dated June 12, 2026, covers 100% of QC Capital for total consideration of US$60,000,000, payable in 20,491,805 Class B ordinary shares. Sellers receive 3% at closing; the remainder is locked for 8 years and released in five equal annual tranches starting from the fourth anniversary. Closing is expected on or before July 24, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee is stated. The deal supports technology development and commercialization. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory conditions; lock-up reduces near-term overhang.
